posts.title: I won a Hugo Award! Plus my Best Fan Writer speech
posts.description: I fought a bad cold during the weekend of the 2026 Worldcon and, despite my best efforts, I fell asleep before the beginning of LACon V’s Hugo Awards ceremony. So imagine my surprise when I woke in the middle of the night and discovered I’d won the Hugo Award for Best Fan Writer. This was the first time in many years I was unable to attend Worldcon. posts.description: I’m attending this year’s Worldcon in Glasgow, Scotland . I’ll also be reporting on Worldcon through my Genre Grapevine and social media accounts. My schedule is below. I look forward to seeing everyone there.
